# Sidhanth S — Full Technical Profile

Focus Areas:

Projects:

## CampusVidhya
Campus workflow platform designed for academic communication, approvals, and operational coordination across students, faculty, and administration.

Stack:
React, Tailwind CSS, Role-Based Access Control, Workflow Automation

## Infenix
Domain-focused AI assistant platform with purpose-built workflows for learning, writing, and summarization.

Stack:
React, AI APIs, Prompt Workflows, Tailwind CSS

## VartalapAI
AI-assisted MSME operations platform focused on invoice digitization, OCR, procurement insights, and GST workflow support.

Stack:
OCR, NLP, Forecasting Systems, Workflow Infrastructure

## CodeLens AI
Repository intelligence system for understanding architecture, domains, dependencies, and structure in unfamiliar codebases.

Stack:
TypeScript, AST Parsing, Graph Visualization, AI Analysis

## Energy Forecast
Electricity demand and price forecasting dashboard built during Infosys Springboard internship.

Stack:
Python, Prophet, Flask, React, Time-Series Forecasting
